name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Safety and validity supervisor that compares surrogate and reference outputs, checks timeout/stale conditions, validates the airspeed envelope, and determines whether the actuator command may be considered valid. It latches faults and can request fault clear handling through software-visible control inputs, but it never generates a substitute command.

feature_contracts.name: feature_1_7c4c3297
feature_contracts.requirement: On reset, the supervisor shall drive a safe inactive output state with no commanded actuation and no open safety gate.

feature_contracts.name: feature_2_0e70d86e
feature_contracts.requirement: When cfg_enable is low, the safety gate shall remain closed and actuator command validity shall be deasserted regardless of other inputs.

feature_contracts.name: feature_3_20004264
feature_contracts.requirement: Airspeed outside the configured envelope shall be flagged invalid and shall inhibit actuator command validity.

feature_contracts.name: feature_4_964ef0f9
feature_contracts.requirement: When surrogate response age is greater than or equal to the configured timeout threshold, the timeout flag shall assert and actuation shall be inhibited.

feature_contracts.name: feature_5_a61ddff0
feature_contracts.requirement: A stale or invalid surrogate response shall inhibit actuation and may latch the fault state; the supervisor must not synthesize a substitute actuator command.

feature_contracts.name: feature_6_a21e1bd5
feature_contracts.requirement: The safety gate may open only when enabled and all monitored safety conditions are satisfied; otherwise the gate remains closed and the actuator command is not valid.

functionality: Evaluates reference-versus-surrogate agreement, freshness, timeout, airspeed envelope, and vehicle-state validity. It asserts safe_gate_open only when command generation is safe and bounded, and otherwise deasserts actuator_cmd_valid while latching fault conditions for software handling. It does not provide or select any fallback actuator command.
responsibilities: Detect timeout and stale surrogate data.
Validate airspeed against configured 20-55 m/s operation envelope.
Compare surrogate command against the transparent reference and configured command bounds.
Permit actuation only when safety conditions are met.
Suppress actuation on invalid or faulted conditions.
reset_behavior: Deasserts actuator_cmd_valid, clears safe_gate_open, and initializes fault/timeout/stale/invalid outputs to a safe reset state. No substitute command is asserted on reset.
behavior_rules: When cfg_enable is low, safe_gate_open remains low and actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted.
Airspeed outside the configured envelope forces invalid_flag and prevents actuation validity.
surrogate_rsp_age greater than or equal to cfg_timeout_cycles asserts timeout_flag and inhibits actuation.
A stale or invalid surrogate response inhibits actuation and may latch fault_latched.
If cfg_clear_fault is asserted, the supervisor may clear the latched fault only when the design rules permit; clearing fault never synthesizes an actuator command.
actuator_cmd_data is only meaningful when actuator_cmd_valid is asserted and remains bounded by cfg_cmd_min/cfg_cmd_max and rate-limit policy.
